findings.message: 1 large-set statement(s) run past 3 lines at 1440px: "I'm Wil Massara, a Gen Z keynote speaker…" → 4 lines at 36px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (something lies over it).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 836px of nothing between: "Send the brief. You will hear back within one busi"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

findings.message: 1 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 1876px at 11648px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Students" (screen 8, 50% hidden); "Wil delivered an energised and engaging presenta" (screen 12, 27% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 3 screens in a row: "Young people lead now."
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: Page scrolls sideways by 7px at 768px. Widest offenders: summary (+7px), summary (+7px), summary (+7px).
findings.fix: Constrain the element that is wider than the viewport (max-width: 100%, or overflow: clip on its section).

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 0px from the left edge but only to 55px from the right, at 390px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit within 12px of the screen edge: "Source: YLAA program records a" (0px from the left)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–20px). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "Young people" (screen 1, 100% over a picture); "lead now." (screen 1, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.
